images.joke: 86–92% held up like Moses
images.note: the rig has no two-arms-up pose: one arm raised to the tablet (wave pose)

images.joke: the road spirals into the black hole
Use my best test ever. / Tested on a 20-minute climb. / Take an optimistic 95%. / Set my Sweet Spot at 235 W.
images.note: clown make-up drawn as flat dots over the rig face (white dabs, blue marks, red nose, orange wig)

images.joke: Sorta-hard, every ride. / Very easy for hours. Very hard when it counts.
THE FOUR HORSEMEN OF TOO MUCH SWEET SPOT: CAN'T GO REALLY HARD / HUNGRY ALL THE TIME / BAD SLEEP / GRUMPY A LOT
You named a training zone the G-Spot? / Yes.
Skip training all winter. / Buy a 10-week Sweet Spot plan. / FTP +30 W! / +30 W from any training at all
just ride easy… and go hard sometimes / Sweet spot maximizes TSS per hour, so if I do 3×20 at 94% four times a week…
Interval 3 of 3×20 at 235 W. PANIK / Relax. It’s only Sweet Spot. 94% of FTP. KALM / Your FTP right now: 215 W. 235 ÷ 215 = 109%. PANIK
Corporate needs you to find the differences between this picture and this picture. / They’re the same picture.

images.note: he sits on the ground (no crate); one arm up, not two (no two-arms-up pose)
